Company: Lenntech 
Location: Delfgauw, Netherlands 
Duration: 6 to 12 months 
Company Description: Lenntech B.V is an international company located in the Netherlands that 
provides water treatment solutions around the world. The company of nearly 60 employees and 20 
different nationalities is divided into several departments: processes for the sizing and sale of systems, 
R&D for research on innovative technologies, engineering for project execution, and a spare parts 
sales department (examples: membranes, filters, pumps, ...). 
Offer: 
As part of a multidisciplinary team, the intern will work with engineers, masters and doctorates alike 
and discover a wide range of technologies such as reverse osmosis, ion exchange and electrodialysis. 
Continuous training will be given on technologies, products and processes depending on research 
projects the intern is involved in. 
The internship will be involved in the following tasks: 
- Lab research 
Performance tests on new membranes and for new applications, proofs of concept studies 
and optimization of operating conditions at lab scale. 
- Pilot scale testing 
Study of the system performance and data collection for further up-scaling: known issues, 
feasibility and operating conditions etc. 
- R&D support 
Bibliographical studies and support of on-going projects. 
Requirements: 
- In engineering school/university in master's degree (first or second year). 
- Fluent in English. 
- Interest in processes and the environment. 
- Flexible, autonomous, curious, team spirit and committed. 
- In possession of EU passport/working permit for the Netherlands. 
Internship compensations: 
- Financial compensation. 
- Housing provided by Lenntech. 
- Bike provided for daily travels. 
Please send your CV / application letter to interns@lenntech.com
